register_unary_ops: register in-place unary operators like torch.add_ and torch.clamp_ into the global operator registry
register_callable_ops: register callable operators like torch.matmul, torch.bmm, and torch.mean into the operator registry
register_buildable_ops: register buildable module operators like torch.nn.Conv2d, torch.nn.Linear, and torch.nn.Dropout
benchmark_unary_op_forward: run the forward pass of a UnaryOp such as torch.add_ on a tensor with no_grad
benchmark_callable_op_forward_backward: run forward and backward passes of a CallableOp like torch.matmul with gradient creation
